description: Selected published linear stellar radii derived from measured angular diameters and parallaxes. These fixed values do not modify HYG astrometry or visual luminosities. Uncertainties are the cited one-sigma errors, not propagated in the renderer.

70666.name: Proxima Centauri
70666.note: Uses the directly interferometric radius. The later frequently adopted 0.1542 R_sun value is inferred from an empirical relation, rather than this measurement.

32263.name: Sirius A
32263.method: Combined SUSI/VLTI interferometry plus Hipparcos parallax
